brief:
Palestine Bank received two awards from the Middle East Investor Relations Association (MIRA) for 2026, the Ma'an news agency reported. The honors recognize the bank's performance in investor communications and engagement.

Details of the specific categories for which Palestine Bank was recognized were not disclosed. The awards reflect MIRA's acknowledgment of the institution's investor relations practices in the regional financial sector.
title: Palestine Bank wins two investor relations awards from Middle East group
